{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print(f"First 5 cleaned revenue values: {sales['revenue_clean'].head(5).tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded.shape[0]}")

# Check if any other sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Unique values in customer_age: {sorted(sales['customer_age'].unique())}")"}
